press_references.value: Canadian arm of China’s largest bank repeatedly broke money-laundering rules despite multiple warnings from regulators

legal_proceedings.description: The Canadian subsidiary of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBK) repeatedly violated anti-money-laundering and anti-terrorist-financing laws, despite multiple warnings from FinTRAC. The bank failed to report suspicious transactions and comply with police production orders, leading to a financial penalty of $701,250 in 2021. FinTRAC's examinations revealed ongoing deficiencies in ICBK's compliance program, raising concerns about the effectiveness of regulatory processes.
